Press Release:


Allergy Clinic
Does the change in season bring on sneezing fits? Do cats or peanuts make your skin break out or chest close up? At best, allergies can ruin your quality of life – at worst, they can be fatal. With the prevalence of allergic diseases like eczema, asthma, hay fever and anaphylaxis rising across the word, it’s estimated one in three South Africans will suffer from an allergy in their lives. Around 40% of sufferers will be children. In a ABC Australia Catalyst Special, allergy experts set up a pop-up clinic in Sydney, Australia – described as the food allergy capital of the world – to test and counsel walk-in patients, to debunk some of the myths and share the latest science in the quest to find cures.
